title: Fill Frequency 10 %: 0.4 mm per row from the bounding box
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0° with 4 mm stitches and Frequency 10 %: each row's needle grid moves 0.4 mm, row k's grid at (k+1)·0.4 mm from the left edge, as in PE-DESIGN's file.

evidence.note: Fill Stitch: Direction, Density, Step pitch, Frequency

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm with the Rectangle tool. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Frequency 10 %, Under sewing unticked, every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default (Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Feathered edge and Gradation off). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50's file, needle point for needle point (±0.15 mm): the row order in halves from the start point, the out-and-back first row, brick row ends, straight ≤ 2 mm travel, Frequency grid from the bounding box and the 0.3 mm tie-in and lock (stitch-rules F3/F6)
